summary: A Monday slate: Sevilla-or-Draw at DraftKings fair price, Sevilla win, PSG (without Dembele, Kvaratskhelia, Marquinhos, Mendes) and Benfica at Santa Clara trimmed 1-2pp toward the books, and Spirit trimmed 2pp after three straight series losses before the Major. Excluded legs cover CS2 opponents outside the HLTV top 30 (TYLOO, DENDELE), Vitality's stand-in, unexplained post-listing drift above the bookmaker (Legacy, NaVi), Jalen Williams as a game-time decision on a back-to-back for OKC, and Challenger/WTA 125 tennis.

verdicts.main_risk: A draw: a tight Santa Clara home side with a 6-game unbeaten home run frustrates Benfica after the Thursday trip to Cyprus.
